task_prompt: Prepare a short report on wage variation in the labor-market survey for the external project-review team. Use the supplied analysis notes; a new calculation is not required. In particular, answer: Calculate the mean and standard deviation of the wage column.
analysis_notes:
The experience_score feature, exper multiplied by looks, has Pearson correlation 0.252 with wage.

The specified twelve-feature wage regression has test RMSE 3.63 with a 70/30 split and random state 42.

The wage-experience Pearson correlation is 0.23.

Wage has mean 6.31 and sample standard deviation 4.66.
